title: Feature request : Automation / If TT = value then ...
body:
It would be very useful if we had the possibility to test for a **value** for temp. target in automations. Actually, the only option is if a TT exists or not.

Usage : if TT set to 140 (exercice) then select sport profile (or use actual profile at 50%) for x min.

TIA

comments.body:
Another use : I have automations to slow down steep positive deltas (TT 75 for 5 min) but I don't want them to kick in when I set TT to 140 and eat fast carbs before exercice... 

If TT <>140 and BG >130 and delta >6 then set TT= 75 for 5 min

Hi, I will also be very interested in the possibility of specifying the TT to better manage periods of sport or low risk.  It would also be a good improvement for automatisms to be able to trigger an action when a specific profile exists.  IF Profile x, then ... For the moment, we cannot use the different profiles as conditions and that is missing.
